description: This source file implements the functions for a Ping Sink Object in a network diagnostic context, specifically handling buffer retrieval, acceptance of new sockets, data reception, closure, and abort procedures. It provides the core operational logic for managing sink-side network ping operations within a broadband home management system.

methods.name: PVOID BbhmDiagipSinkGetRecvBuffer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PANSC_HANDLE phRecvHandle,PULONG pulSize)
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer from the sink object for receiving data, providing the buffer pointer and size.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipSinkAccept(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hNewSocket)
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a new socket connection, currently creates a new sink object and immediately removes it (possible placeholder logic).

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipSinkRecv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hRecvHandle,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Invokes the reception handler in the parent ping object when data is received.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipSinkClose(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bByPeer)
methods.description: Closes the sink, resetting its internal state.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipSinkAbort(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Handles critical failure by resetting the sink.
